_meta.purpose: External Chinese official baselines used to judge whether the simulated life matches a real Chinese life, stage by stage.
_meta.collectedBy: headless audit session (main agent verified tier A pages personally; tier B pages were opened by delegated research runs and are marked with the read method)

tiers.A: 原文由本次审计主进程亲自 web_fetch 打开并在返回正文中逐字看到该数字。可直接作为基线。
tiers.B: 由本次审计派出的取证任务真实打开了页面（含统计局年鉴 JPG 表格的图片读数）。可作基线，但复用时应能容忍读数误差，年鉴图片读数需标 OCR。
tiers.C: 只拿到搜索摘要 / 二手转引 / 官方原页 404 / 官方根本无此口径。禁止当作硬基线，只能作为方向性参考，且必须在结论里标注。

_meta.hard_rule: Any assertion in FIX-BRIEF / LIFE-STAGE-REVIEW that cites a C-tier item is advisory only and must not be written as a confirmed defect. If a C-tier item is later upgraded to A/B, re-run the gate before changing the verdict.
_meta.unit_note: Money inside the game is declared by the engine itself as 'CNY-2025-model' fixed purchasing power, so period prices are compared after CPI deflation to 2025 prices, never nominal-to-nominal across decades.
_meta.hard_rule_c: 凡引用 C 级条目的断言一律为"待核/方向性"，不得写"已核实"；本轮官方从未发布过 1949-1977 出生人口绝对数、全国逐年初婚年龄、分年龄死亡率一手表，这三项永久标记为缺口。

engine_side_anchors.note: These are the audited engine's OWN published anchors, used together with the external baselines so that a conclusion is always produced by the audited system plus a cited external number.
